workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: send_final_ledgered prunes a reply that reported success with no message_id
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(telegram): an id-less sendRichMessage is an unknown delivery, not a success. Target files: plugins/platforms/telegram/adapter.py, plugins/platforms/telegram/telegram_send_errors.py, contributors/emails/[REDACTED]. On Telegram, `sendRichMessage` could be accepted with a result that carries no `message_id`, and `_try_send_rich` still returned `SendResult(success=True, message_id=None)`. The delivery ledger finalizes on `success` and prunes a delivered row. So a reply that never reached th... (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/153513)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: bounded hosted-room transcript drops source users still referenced by settlements
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(gateway): retain sources for bounded settlements. Target files: gateway/hosted_room_policy_checkpoint.py, tests/tui_gateway/test_hosted_room_policy_upgrade.py. Keeps the canonical user discussion in a bounded hosted-room policy snapshot when a retained non-pass settlement still references it. This prevents a later planner pass from rejecting the settlement as orphaned after normal transcript eviction. (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139400)

workarounds.symptom: Terminal tool: false positive blocking npm update/install commands containing 'vite'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Terminal no longer refuses harmless commands that only mention a dev server (salvage #150773, #108599, #95481). Target files: tools/terminal_tool_guards.py, tests/tools/test_terminal_guard_command_position.py. The terminal tool refused harmless commands that merely mention a dev server (`grep -rn uvicorn .`, `ls node_modules/vite`, `npm install nodemon`), telling the model to run them in the background. Those now run; commands that actually start a server are refused exactly as before. (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/153382)

Before: a file sent to Telegram could reach the chat while Hermes reported "Timed out" / "Couldn't deliver the file attachment", because Hermes stopped waiting for Telegram's answer after a fixed 60s (gateway) or 20s (`hermes send`), whatever the file size. Now an uploa... (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/151797)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Async delegate child dies with KeyError(<parent session id>) once the parent's live session is gone (inherited local-viewer print sink)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(gateway): recover from a background subagent's failure while its parent chat is idle. Target files: gateway/run_notifications.py, gateway/session_authority.py, gateway/session_automation.py. When Hermes hands a job to a helper agent and that helper fails, for example because the AI provider's safety filter refused the request, the main conversation used to stay silent until you came back and asked what happened. Worse, the real reason was sometimes lost and replaced by a meaningless error. Now the failure com... (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/149568)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: connect_tracked: a tracked connection garbage-collected without close() stays "live" in the registry until restart
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(state): release a tracked connection's entry only after SQLite has closed its files. Target files: hermes_cli/sqlite_safe_read.py, tests/hermes_cli/test_sqlite_safe_read_finalizer.py. Makes a tracked SQLite connection release its registry entry when it's garbage-collected without `close()`, and never before its files are actually closed. (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/149309)

workarounds.symptom: xAI grok-4.7 compression no-ops on encrypted reasoning, then structural_backoff blocks retry
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Long Codex, xAI and Claude chats no longer hide their reasoning from compression (#125920). Target files: agent/context_compressor.py, agent/context_compressor_tail.py, agent/message_metadata.py. On Codex, xAI and Claude, the model's hidden reasoning from earlier turns is sent back on every call, and the provider bills for it. Hermes counted that reasoning as zero (or, for Claude, as its much shorter summary), so compression thought a heavy session was small, found "nothing to cut" and blocked itself, while the r... (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/152422)

workarounds.symptom: Telegram gateway: silent polling death — bot reports connected but never delivers inbound messages
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(telegram): a wedged PTB dispatcher is reported instead of staying silently deaf (refs #102260, salvage #102383). Target files: gateway/platforms/base.py, plugins/platforms/telegram/adapter.py, tests/gateway/test_telegram_ingress_delivery_gap.py. A Telegram gateway whose PTB dispatcher has wedged now logs a WARNING naming the stall, instead of publishing `connected` while every fetched update sits undispatched. (Ref: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/109318)
